title: Three Nights and One Short Script
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：performance　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 performance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the director ① gave the performance that no actor in the theatre would have described, and he said the giving was the whole of the night. The ② performance, meaning the show itself and not the script, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a performance, he said, is the only thing in a theatre that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ performance in that theatre had the same short script beside it, and the ④ performance at the far stage, meaning the prop they kept for the children to move and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A performance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the director said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the performance was the whole of the matter, meaning the effort and not the show. The ⑥ performance, meaning the effort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; performance, he said, is either something you give or the only word that means both a show and an effort. He said the effort is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ performance had become a line in a poster, and the poster had become an argument about the short script. The ⑧ performance of the whole thing, the director wrote in August, was one theatre and three nights of describing; performance, he said, is either the prop at the far stage or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ performance I remember is the show described in the poster, which closed in 1983 and is still described as the quietest in the theatre. A ⑩ performance, my mother said in 1985, is the only show that improves by being described; every performance, she said, is an effort that has agreed to look like a show. She said the effort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 表演；表现（指戏院里每一场旁边的那一场）
B. n. 表演；表现（指那场表演本身，与薄薄的剧本相对）
C. 固定搭配：give the performance 拿出这一场表演
D. n. 表演；表现（指留给孩子们搬的那一件）
E. n. 表演之事（抽象总称，指一处戏院的表演之事）
F. n. 表演；表现（指戏报里写到、被描述的那一场）
G. n. 表演、功夫（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 功夫（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: gave the performance that no actor in the theatre would have described
The performance, meaning the show itself and not the script
the performance at the far stage
the performance was the whole of the matter
the performance had become a line in a poster
The performance of the whole thing
A performance, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: give the performance 意为“拿出这一场表演”，1976 年那位导演把戏院里没有一位演员肯描述的一场表演做了一遍。
performance 意为“表演；表现”，指那场表演本身而不是薄薄的剧本，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
performance 意为“表演；表现”，指戏院里每一场旁边的那一场，每一场旁边都有同一册薄薄的剧本。
performance 意为“表演；表现”，指最远那处台口的留给孩子们搬的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
performance 意为“表演、功夫”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这场功夫就是那件事的全部。
performance 意为“功夫”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那场表演，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
performance 意为“表演；表现”，指戏报里写到、被描述的那一场，到 1981 年这一场成了戏报里的一行。
performance 意为“表演之事”，导演八月写道，整件事的表演之事是一处戏院和三个夜晚的描述。
performance 意为“表演；表现”，我记得的是戏报里描述过的那一场，1983 年演完了，至今仍被说成戏院里最安静的一场。
performance 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，表演是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的表演。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年那位导演拿出了戏院里没有一位演员肯描述的一场表演，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（give the performance）
那场表演，指的是那场表演本身而不是薄薄的剧本，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。（performance）
那处戏院里每一场表演旁边都有同一册薄薄的剧本。（performance）
最远那处台口那场表演，指的是他们留给孩子们搬的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（performance）
叔叔说这场功夫就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那场表演。（performance）
1985 年母亲说，表演是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的表演。（performance）
